items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: I guess McCurdy wasn't doing so well in those days.

ctx.x: Do you remember who was in the band? Mm-hm.

Mm-hm. Charlie Booker. And they said he was getting sort of rusty and a little old. He couldn't finger like he used to. And the leader said, oh, we can't use him. So Manuel said, I'll tell you who to get. This man, as long as he lives, he'll play as well as he ever did. He said, you send for Mr. Peek Coot. That's it. That's it. That's it. You said the right thing. Yeah, Manuel said, as long as that man lives, he's going to play. Send for me. That's what he said. Yes, indeed. You're right. You're right. Pete Coot…
I can't really play at all. I'd sure like to hear you play, though, Alphonse.
